'''AX-871''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] who fought in the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle of Kuat]] during the [[Galactic War]], where it was destroyed aboard the [[Kuat Defensive Station]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
AX-871 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' expansion, added to the game with Update 2.6.
